The probability of the trinary sentiment score (above) matching a known sentiment state alone: 0.000 = zero probability, 1.000 is absolute probability.
Identifies if the item is headline only or if there is a body as well. "T" = true, for headline only, "F" = false, indicating there is a body to the story.
The estimated risk-adjusted 1 minute forward return for a given article as measured by stock return minus the stock beta multiplied market return, -5 being most negative impact and +5 most positive.
Identifies new stories: 1 = new story, 2 or greater means the item is linked to a previous story that was published within the last 24 hours.
Sentiment probability: The raw probability that the article sentiment is negative expressed as a decimal with all three probabilities summing to 1.
Sentiment probability: The raw probability that the article sentiment is neutral expressed as a decimal with all three probabilities summing to 1.
Sentiment probability: The raw probability that the article sentiment is positive expressed as a decimal with all three probabilities summing to 1.
Weighting of the sentiment to the company in that line of data. Relevance of "1.00" = primary relevance, any less indicates the appropriate degree of relevance.
Reveals in a trinary score the highest probable state of sentiment found in the news item, 1 = positive, 0 = neutral, and -1 = negative.
The publication timestamp of the news item in UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) by default.
Indicates whether the news story was automatically generated as part of a scheduled delivery (e.g., calendar event or systematic feed); 1 or "T" is scheduled, 0 or "F" is unscheduled
Confidence level (0 to 1) that the sentiment score accurately matches the news item’s actual sentiment
Flag indicating if the item contains only a headline (1/“T”) or includes full article/text (0/“F”)
Estimated risk-adjusted 1-minute forward return expected from the news event, roughly ranging from -5 to +5
Indicator of story novelty: 1 = first/new story, >1 = repeat or update linked to previous stories in last 24 hours
Model-assigned probability (0 to 1) that the sentiment of the news article is negative; all three probabilities (positive, neutral, negative) sum to 1
The raw probability that the news article’s sentiment is classified as neutral, expressed as a decimal (with the probabilities for positive, neutral, and negative sentiment summing to 1)
Model-assigned probability (0 to 1) that the sentiment of the news article is positive; all three probabilities (positive, neutral, negative) sum to 1
Degree to which the news item focuses on the target company; 1 = primary, <1 = secondary/side mention
Trinary sentiment classification for the news item: 1 = positive, 0 = neutral, -1 = negative
UTC Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) marking the exact publication time of the news article for point-in-time analysis
Fiscal year identifier (numeric)
Sequence number within the fiscal year/period (e.g., 1 for Q1)
Metric code as an integer
Numeric value of the operating metric
Number of months or weeks covered by the reporting period, depending on reporting practices
Numeric code for reporting frequency; 1=annual, 2=quarterly, 3=semi-annual, 4=trimester
Code for statement context: 1=Profit & Loss, 3=Balance Sheet

Update type provides information on how statements were formulated. Options include: UPD - Update Normal, UCA - Update Calculated, USP - Update Special, RES - Restated Normal, RCA - Restated Calculated, RSP - Restated Special, CLA - Reclassified Normal, CCA - Reclassified Calculated, CSP - Reclassified Special
Composite Performance Deviation Index over 3 quarters, aggregating all PDI3 factors using risk parity weighting to reflect overall abnormal absolute deviation across core fundamentals

Composite quality-adjusted performance deviation index over 3 trailing quarters, aggregating standardized deviations of multiple financial ratios (QPDI3 factors) across clusters using risk parity weighting
Composite PDI score aggregated from raw four-quarter PDI factors using risk parity weighting, showing a holistic measure of absolute fundamental deviation

Composite quality PDI score over 4 trailing quarters, aggregating all quality-adjusted PDI factors by clustering similar metrics, equal-weighting within clusters and risk parity weighting across clusters, to summarize deviations in quality ratios
Composite PDI score aggregating all PDI factors over 5 trailing quarters using risk parity weighting; summarizes absolute magnitude of fundamental deviations in accounting variables

Composite Quality-adjusted PDI score over 5 trailing quarters, aggregating QPDI5 factors across seven fundamental clusters with risk parity weighting, providing an overall measure of multi-ratio quality deviations from historical baselines
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters based on Return on Assets (ROA), measuring deviation of ROA ratio from historical average
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 4 trailing quarters based on Return on Assets (Net Income divided by total assets), showing deviation in asset profitability versus history
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 5 quarters for return on assets, capturing deviations in firm profitability (net income / average assets) compared to historical baseline

Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters, measuring deviation of long-term debt from historical levels, providing insight into changes in firm leverage in absolute terms, scaled for firm size
Performance Deviation Index over 4 trailing quarters measuring deviation of long-term debt from historical norm, likely scaled by firm size (e.g., total assets)
Performance Deviation Index over 5 trailing quarters, measuring the absolute deviation of a firm's long-term debt from its historical norm, scaled by firm size
3-quarter absolute-level PDI factor measuring deviation in property, plant, and equipment over the last 3 quarters versus historical trend, scaled by firm size
4-quarter absolute-level PDI factor measuring deviation in the amount of property, plant, and equipment (PPE) from its historical trend, typically scaled by total assets for comparability
Performance Deviation Index over trailing 5 quarters based on Property, Plant & Equipment (PPE), likely representing deviation in the carrying value of fixed assets versus historical trend
Raw Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters, measuring the deviation in retained earnings from its historical norm, scaled by size
PDI-4 Factor based on Retained Earnings
Performance Deviation Index over trailing 5 quarters for retained earnings (cumulative net earnings retained in equity), measuring deviation from historical average
Deviation over the past 3 quarters of the firm's net income (scaled by firm size) from its historical average, capturing recent abnormal earnings changes
Performance Deviation Index over 4 trailing quarters based on absolute net income, measuring how much net earnings deviate from the firm's historical average, size-scaled
Raw PDI factor over 5 trailing quarters measuring deviation in net income (scaled by firm size) from its long-term average
Performance Deviation Index (PDI) over 3 quarters for Cash Flow from Operations (CFO), quantifying how much operational cash flows deviate from historical norms, adjusted for firm scale
Performance Deviation Index (PDI) over 4 quarters for Cash Flow from Operations (CFO), indicating deviations in operating cash flow against baseline historical values, scaled by firm size
Performance Deviation Index (PDI) over 5 quarters for Cash Flow from Operations (CFO), capturing the deviation of operational cash flows from prior periods, scaled for comparability
Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters measuring the deviation of accounts payable from its historical norm, likely scaled by firm size
Performance Deviation Index over trailing 4 quarters for absolute accounts payable, scaled, quantifying deviation from its historical baseline
Performance Deviation Index over 5 trailing quarters, measuring the absolute deviation of Accounts Payable (amount owed to suppliers) from its historical norm, scaled by firm size
Absolute deviation over the past 3 quarters in the firm's capital surplus (excess paid-in capital), scaled for firm size
Deviation in the firm's total cash holdings, measured at an absolute level over 3 trailing quarters and scaled by firm size to identify abnormal cash accumulation or depletion
Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters, measuring absolute deviation in EBITDA from the firm's historical norm, scaled by firm size
Raw Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters, quantifying how much the firm's sales have deviated from their historical norm, scaled for comparability
Performance Deviation Index over 4 quarters for Capital Surplus, measuring its deviation from the historical or expected value
PDI factor quantifying the absolute deviation in cash levels from the firm’s historical norm over the trailing 4 quarters, scaled by size
Performance Deviation Index (PDI) over 4 quarters for EBITDA, measuring deviation of EBITDA from its historical baseline, scaled by total assets or similar size variable
Performance Deviation Index over 4 trailing quarters based on absolute sales (turnover), measuring deviation of firm's sales from its recent historical level, typically scaled by assets or size
Performance Deviation Index over five trailing quarters for capital surplus, quantifying absolute deviation from its historical values, size-standardized

The PDI factor over 5 trailing quarters, measuring the deviation in the firm's cash holdings from its historical average, scaled appropriately to account for size, indicating changes in cash management or liquidity
Performance Deviation Index (PDI) over 5 quarters for EBITDA, measuring the deviation in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization relative to historical norms, size-adjusted
Performance Deviation Index over trailing 5 quarters based on absolute sales revenue, scaled appropriately, capturing deviation in sales versus historical average
The PDI factor over 3 trailing quarters, measuring the deviation of the firm's Gross Profit from its historical average, scaled for size, reflecting recent shifts in core profitability
Performance Deviation Index over 4 quarters measuring the deviation of Gross Profit from its expected or average value (absolute, scaled by size)
Raw PDI factor over 5 trailing quarters measuring deviation in gross profit (scaled appropriately) from its historical value
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 3 quarters capturing deviation in the Berry Ratio (Gross Profit / Operating Expenses), measuring changes in profitability efficiency over that window
Quality-adjusted PDI factor measuring deviation of operating cash flow to current liabilities ratio over the trailing 3 quarters
Quality-adjusted PDI over 3 trailing quarters based on Cash Flow Return on Net Operating Assets, tracking deviation from the historical baseline for this ratio
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 3 quarters measuring deviation in Cash Flow Return on Assets from its norm

3-quarter quality-adjusted PDI factor measuring deviation in cash flow return on equity (cash flow from operations divided by equity) from its historical baseline, reflecting cash flow profitability trends
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 3 quarters for the current ratio (Current Assets / Current Liabilities), measuring the deviation in liquidity from its historical norm
Three-quarter trailing quality-adjusted PDI factor measuring deviation in the Debt-to-Capital ratio (Total Debt / [Debt + Shareholders’ Equity]) relative to its historical baseline
Quality-adjusted Performance Deviation Index over 3 trailing quarters, measuring the deviation of the company's Debt to Equity ratio from its historical average
